metadata.title: Velyric – the AI voice agent that answers every call
metadata.description: Velyric's AI voice agent answers your calls day and night in English, German and Hungarian, books appointments, and hands over to your team when needed.

brand.tagline: AI voice agents for modern businesses

hero.eyebrow: AI voice agents for modern businesses
hero.titleLine2: day and night, in your language.
hero.subtitle: Velyric's voice agent picks up the phone like your best receptionist: friendly, natural, and it books the appointment right away. You stay focused on your work.

call.t1: Hi! I'd like a haircut tomorrow afternoon.
call.t2: Happy to help! We have 2:00 pm or 4:30 pm tomorrow. Which would you like?
call.t4: Great, you're booked for tomorrow at 2:00 pm. See you then!

s1.title: The phone rings. Velyric has already answered.
s1.text: It picks up on the first ring — at dawn, on weekends and at peak hours. No busy line, no missed customer.
s1.bubble: “Hello, you've reached Bella Salon. How can I help?”

s2.title: It talks like your best team member.
s2.text: Natural, human speech — it keeps up even when callers interrupt or change topic. If they call in German or English, it switches language.
s2.bubble: “Of course! Which service, and when would suit you?”

s3.title: It books. It answers. It gets it done.
s3.text: It checks your calendar, books the free slot, and answers common questions with your answers: prices, opening hours, parking.

s4.title: When a human is needed, it hands over — with a summary.
s4.text: For complex cases it transfers the call to your colleague and sends the gist of the conversation. Nobody has to repeat themselves.
s4.bubble: Transferred to Anna, with a summary

about.title: A team that stands by you — in person.
about.p1: We're building Velyric so that no business ever loses a customer to an unanswered call.
about.p2: We don't hand you boxed software. We learn how your business works and tailor the voice agent to your needs and your tone.

simple.title: Simple
simple.text: No IT team needed. We set it up and train it — you just see the results.

hungarian.title: Local
hungarian.text: A Hungarian team with real support, and a voice agent that truly understands your callers.

reliable.title: Reliable
reliable.text: It works around the clock, your data is handled securely, and you can always reach us.

personal.title: We come to you and build it around your business.
personal.text: Every business is different. That's why we don't install a template: together we plan what it says, what it knows and when it hands over.
personal.imageAlt: Two people at a table reviewing a document together

visit.title: On-site assessment
visit.text: We visit you and look at who calls, what they ask and when traffic peaks.

tailor.title: Tailoring
tailor.text: We write the conversations in your style — prices, services, opening hours — and connect your calendar.

launch.title: Launch and fine-tuning
launch.text: We test it together, go live, and keep refining it based on real calls in the first weeks.

features.title: Everything a great receptionist does. Tirelessly.

conversation.title: Natural conversation
conversation.text: It speaks smoothly with a human voice — callers often don't notice they're talking to AI.

booking.title: Appointment booking
booking.text: It sees your calendar in real time and books, moves or cancels appointments without clashes.

handoff.title: Smart handover
handoff.text: When a human is needed it transfers instantly and sends a summary, so nobody starts over.

languages.title: Multilingual
languages.text: It speaks Hungarian, German and English, and switches to the caller's language on its own.

allDay.title: Available 24/7
allDay.text: Weekends, holidays, nights — it always picks up. Never sick, never on vacation.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: See who called, what they wanted and how it ended — in clear reports.

features.intro: One call from start to finish, and where each capability does its work.

useCases.title: Anyone whose phone keeps ringing.
useCases.text: If calls matter but there isn't always someone to answer — Velyric is made for you.

salon.quote: Could I book a colour for tomorrow?

salon.agent: We have 10:00 am or 3:00 pm tomorrow. Which would you like?

clinic.quote: Can I move my Thursday check-up?
clinic.agent: I've moved it to next Thursday at 8:30 am. Does that work?

service.agent: We can see you Tuesday at 8:00 am. What's wrong with the car?

cta.title: Never miss another call.
cta.text: Show us how your business works — we'll show you how many customers you can win back.

footer.tagline: AI voice agents for modern businesses. Day and night.

demo.title: What a call sounds like
demo.text: A typical call to a dental practice: Velyric finds a slot, then hands a question over to the front desk.
demo.t1: Hello, I need a teeth cleaning next week.
demo.t2: Happy to help. We can see you Tuesday at 9:00 am or Thursday at 3:30 pm. Which suits you?
demo.t3: Thursday is good. Does my insurance cover it?
demo.t4: You're booked for Thursday at 3:30 pm. My colleague can answer the insurance question best, I'll put you through.
demo.handoff: Transferred to the front desk, with a summary
demo.note: Illustrative example. Real conversations are tailored to your business.
